title: bigbio/sdrf-agentic-annotator pipeline parameters
description: Annotate PRIDE datasets with SDRF using Nextflow agents and the bigbio/sdrf-skills

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a samplesheet with one PXD accession per row (annotate) or, in refine mode, PXD plus an optional `ref_sdrf` path column.
input.help_text: Annotate mode: one column with the header `pxd`. Refine mode (`--refine`): columns `pxd` and an optional `ref_sdrf` (absolute path to the existing SDRF to refine; if empty it is fetched from bigbio/sdrf-annotated-datasets). Sample: pxd,ref_sdrf\nPXD074155,/data/PXD074155.sdrf.tsv. See the usage docs.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

agent_options.title: Agent options
agent_options.description: Options for the LLM agents. The API key is the Nextflow secret `LLM_KEY`.

model.description: Model that the agents use, as `<provider>/<model>`.

api_provider.description: Provider of the API key in the `LLM_KEY` secret.
api_provider.help_text: Either a built-in provider such as `google`, `anthropic`, `openai` or `openrouter`, or the provider key you registered in `models.json` for an OpenAI-compatible gateway (e.g. `ebi`). The `<provider>` prefix of `--model` must match this value.

prefill.description: Before the annotate agent, extract the facts the PRIDE record already states (organism, instrument, enzymes, labels, run files) with a non-agent step and give them to the agent.

revise.description: Revise an SDRF when its review fails, then review it again (up to `max_revise` rounds).

max_revise.description: Maximum number of revise -> re-review rounds a dataset may go through (0 to 2). Refine mode revises at most once.

max_parallel.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks of each process (each agent and the coverage step); 0 = the default of 10.

coverage_min.description: If an SDRF annotates less than this fraction (0..1) of the deposited runs, the reviewer must treat it as an important finding unless the artifact honestly declares itself a subset. 0.0 = informational only.

subset_mode.description: Permit a clearly-declared representative subset (e.g. a huge DIA deposit) to be accepted instead of failing on under-representation.

confidence_gate.description: Flag PASSes with confidence below this threshold (0..1), or without a confidence, as LOW_CONF. 0.0 = no gating.

exit_on_review_fail.description: Make the run exit non-zero when any dataset's final verdict is FAIL.

fail_fast.description: Stop the whole run when an agent task still fails after its retries. By default that task is skipped and the other PXDs carry on.

models_json.description: Absolute path to a pi `models.json` that adds an OpenAI-compatible gateway as a provider.
models_json.help_text: The `docker` profile mounts the file with `-v`; the `singularity` and `apptainer` profiles with `-B`, all read-only at `/opt/pi-config/models.json` in the agent container. Do not put the API key in the file. See the usage docs.

max_fetch_bytes.description: The agents do not download a remote file larger than this number of bytes.

refine_options.title: Refine options
refine_options.description: Options for refine mode: refine an already-published SDRF and accept the refined version only if it is strictly better annotated.

refine.description: Run in refine mode: take the existing SDRF for each PXD (from the optional `ref_sdrf` path in the samplesheet, or fetched from bigbio/sdrf-annotated-datasets), refine it by seeded re-annotation, and only accept the refined version if it scores strictly better (verdict/confidence + coverage) on the same independent review. Otherwise keep the original.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
